# Alpha

Alpha collects research notes and keeps the open-question list honest.

Each source gets a dated line with a one-sentence takeaway.

Numbers are recorded exactly as measured, never rounded for style.

Open questions move to resolved only with a linked measurement.

Weekly, prune notes that no longer inform any open question.

Duplicate takeaways are merged and the earlier date is kept.

When evidence conflicts, keep both lines and flag the conflict.

Cross-check operational context in [Notes](references/notes.md).
